name: Resampling
description: Bootstrap confidence intervals and permutation tests for one, two, paired and k samples
whenToUse: When a statistic of one, two, paired or k samples needs a confidence interval or a test without assuming a distribution: bootstraps the interval (BCa or percentile) and tests by permutation (two samples, paired, k groups) or against a target value (one sample). Each sample needs at least 2 numeric values (10 for Ppk).
stale: Result outdated – the inputs have changed. Please recompute.
bcaFallback: BCa not available (e.g. replicates without spread) – percentile interval shown.
chartPermTitleDiff: {stat}: difference {a} − {b} with groups reshuffled at random (H₀)
chartPermTitleRatio: {stat}: log ratio ln({a} / {b}) with groups reshuffled at random (H₀)
chartPermTitlePaired: {stat} of the differences {a} − {b} with signs flipped at random (H₀)
chartPermTitleK: Global test statistic across {groups} with groups reshuffled at random (H₀)
errStatisticMode: This statistic is not available in the selected mode.
errTrim: The trim fraction must be at least 0 and below 0.5.
errQuantileP: p must lie strictly between 0 and 1.
errLimitsMissing: Ppk needs at least one valid spec limit.
errLimitsOrder: The lower spec limit must be below the upper one.
errConfidence: The confidence level must lie between 0 and 1.
errB: B must be a whole number between 1,000 and 100,000.
errSeed: The seed must be a whole number between 0 and 2,147,483,647.
errTarget: The target value is not a valid number.
errMinGroups: k samples need at least 3 columns.
errMinValues: Every sample needs at least 2 numeric values.
errMinPpk: Ppk needs at least 10 numeric values per sample.
errRatioPositive: The ratio needs all values to be positive.
errRatioStatistic: For a ratio the statistic must be positive in both groups.
errDegenerateStatistic: The test statistic is not defined for these data (e.g. Ppk or CV of a constant group).
stmtTwoSig: {a} and {b} differ significantly in the {stat} ({p} < α = {alpha}).
stmtTwoSigGreater: {a} is significantly higher than {b} in the {stat} ({p} < α = {alpha}).
stmtTwoSigLess: {a} is significantly lower than {b} in the {stat} ({p} < α = {alpha}).
stmtTwoNot: No significant difference between {a} and {b} in the {stat} ({p} ≥ α = {alpha}).
stmtTwoNotGreater: {a} is not significantly higher than {b} in the {stat} ({p} ≥ α = {alpha}).
stmtTwoNotLess: {a} is not significantly lower than {b} in the {stat} ({p} ≥ α = {alpha}).
stmtDiffAbove: The estimate for {a} is {diff} above that for {b}.
stmtDiffBelow: The estimate for {a} is {diff} below that for {b}.
stmtDiffEqual: The estimates for {a} and {b} are equal.
stmtRatio: The estimate for {a} is {ratio} times that for {b}.
stmtIntervalDiff: A plausible difference lies between {lo} and {hi} ({conf} % confidence interval).
stmtIntervalRatio: A plausible factor lies between {lo} and {hi} ({conf} % confidence interval).
stmtPairedSig: The paired differences {a} − {b} deviate significantly from 0 in the {stat} ({p} < α = {alpha}).
stmtPairedSigGreater: The paired differences {a} − {b} are significantly above 0 in the {stat} ({p} < α = {alpha}).
stmtPairedSigLess: The paired differences {a} − {b} are significantly below 0 in the {stat} ({p} < α = {alpha}).
stmtPairedNot: The paired differences {a} − {b} do not deviate significantly from 0 in the {stat} ({p} ≥ α = {alpha}).
stmtPairedNotGreater: The paired differences {a} − {b} are not significantly above 0 in the {stat} ({p} ≥ α = {alpha}).
stmtPairedNotLess: The paired differences {a} − {b} are not significantly below 0 in the {stat} ({p} ≥ α = {alpha}).
stmtPairedEstimate: The estimate of the differences {a} − {b} is {est}.
stmtOneEstimate: The {stat} of {a} is estimated at {est}; plausible values lie between {lo} and {hi} ({conf} % confidence interval).
stmtOneReject: The interval does not contain the target {target} – the deviation from the target is significant.
stmtOneRetain: The interval contains the target {target} – no significant difference from the target.
stmtKSig: At least one of the groups {groups} differs significantly in the {stat} ({p} < α = {alpha}).
stmtKNot: No significant difference between the groups {groups} in the {stat} ({p} ≥ α = {alpha}).
stmtKPairs: Significant after Holm correction (difference of estimates): {pairs}.
stmtKNoPair: After Holm correction, however, no single pair of groups is significant.
